thread.title: Hastings Education Foundation to hold gala with music and auction in April
thread.title_full: Hastings Education Foundation to hold gala with music and auction in April

author: t. s. hildebrand
title: Hastings Education Foundation to hold gala with music and auction in April
text:
The Hastings Education Foundation announced on April 8 that it will host a gala event inspired by the clubbing scene of 1990s and early 2000s New York City. The event is open to the community and aims to offer a night of entertainment, live music, dancing, and an auction.
The foundation said the gala will feature DJs, live performances, and continuous dancing throughout the evening. Attendees can expect beer and wine service as well as food from local vendors. A free bus service will be provided for easy transportation to and from the venue.
Organizers highlighted that there will be a selection of auction items available for bidding during the event. Details about ticket purchases are available on the Village of Hastings-on-Hudson website at http://hohny.gov .
The event is intended to bring together members of the community for an enjoyable night while supporting educational initiatives in Hastings-on-Hudson.
More information about tickets and logistics can be found through official channels as preparations continue.
